name: tumor-hot-cold
description: Classify TCGA tumors as hot / cold / immune-excluded from cBioPortal RNA expression z-scores across two immunology layers (immune infiltration and immunosuppression), with no bulk dataset download.
author: ClawBio Hackathon
capabilities: Fetch per-gene, per-sample mRNA expression z-scores from the cBioPortal public REST API (targeted queries, no bulk download)
Score Layer 1 immune infiltration (CD8A, CD4, FOXP3, CD68, NCAM1, CD19)
Score Layer 2 immunosuppression / checkpoint-exhaustion (TIGIT, LAG3, HAVCR2, PDCD1, CD274, IL10, TGFB1, CTLA4)
Combine both layers into a hot / cold / immune-excluded classification per tumor
Emit report.md, result.json and a reproducibility bundle

input_formats.required_fields: study_id, sample_id (one per line, tab or comma separated)
